name: AXFRA White Seamless Studio
mood: clean, minimalist, editorial, professional photography studio
style: Alarsi editorial style, ultra photorealistic high-fashion outdoor portrait, cinematic natural lighting, Vogue-level luxury aesthetic, hyper-detailed skin pores, realistic wet surfaces, accurate water physics, no smoothing, no plastic look, masterpiece, best quality

definitions.default: Preserve the exact body orientation and viewing angle from the reference image
definitions.three_quarter: Subject rotated approximately 45 degrees relative to the camera
definitions.left_profile: Subject facing left, approximately 90 degrees from the camera
definitions.right_profile: Subject facing right, approximately 90 degrees from the camera
definitions.back: Subject facing away from the camera, back view

subject_placement.grounding: feet naturally placed on the studio floor
subject_placement.integration: realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and lighting consistent with the studio environment
subject_placement.identity_preservation: preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions and clothing from the reference image
subject_placement.restriction: do not invent, replace or redesign the original subject

framing.body_visibility: entire body visible from head to feet
framing.cropping: no cropping of head, hands or feet
framing.scale: subject occupies a natural central proportion of the frame
framing.camera_relation: subject clearly readable within the full studio setup
framing.priority: preserve the original subject while reframing to a centered full-body composition

background.structure: paper or vinyl sweep extending from vertical background to floor

primary_seat.restriction: must not block the subject's body or interfere with full-body framing
